metadata.question: Was there a decrease in rainfall in Zimbabwe in February 2024 compared to February 2023?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: CHIRPS (Climate Hazards Group InfraRed Precipitation with Station data) - daily precipitation dataset - Date: February 2023 (2023-02-01 to 2023-02-28) vs February 2024 (2024-02-01 to 2024-02-29) - Location: Zimbabwe country boundary 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed - CHIRPS is a precipitation product - Simply sum/mean the precipitation values for each February period 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Total precipitation could legitimately be very low (drought) - Check collection size first (C1 if empty) - Check pixel count after processing (C2 if 0 valid pixels) - Check if result is None/NaN (C3) - If both values are valid numbers, compare them: decrease = (2024 < 2023) → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const zimbabwe = ee.FeatureCollection('USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017') .filter(ee.Filter.eq('country_na', 'Zimbabwe')) .geometry(); const date2023Start = '2023-02-01'; const date2023End = '2023-02-28'; const date2024Start = '2024-02-01'; const date2024End = '2024-02-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check const chirps2023 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(date2023Start, date2023End) .filterBounds(zimbabwe); const chirps2024 = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(date2024Start, date2024End) .filterBounds(zimbabwe); const size2023 = await chirps2023.size().getInfo(); const size2024 = await chirps2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2023 Images: ${size2023}`); console.log(`Feb 2024 Images: ${size2024}`); if (size2023 === 0 || size2024 === 0) { console.log("No data available for one or both periods."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation for each period const precip2023 = chirps2023.sum().select('precipitation'); const precip2024 = chirps2024.sum().select('precipitation'); // Check pixel counts const count2023 = await precip2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: zimbabwe, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const count2024 = await precip2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: zimbabwe, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2023 Valid Pixels: ${count2023}`); console.log(`Feb 2024 Valid Pixels: ${count2024}`); if (count2023 === 0 || count2024 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculate mean total precipitation const stats2023 = await precip2023.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: zimbabwe, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); const stats2024 = await precip2024.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: zimbabwe, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2023 Mean Total Precip: ${stats2023 !== null ? stats2023.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm`); console.log(`Feb 2024 Mean Total Precip: ${stats2024 !== null ? stats2024.toFixed(2) : 'null'} mm`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (stats2023 === null || stats2024 === null || isNaN(stats2023) || isNaN(stats2024) || stats2023 < 0 || stats2024 < 0) { console.log("Calculation failed or invalid results."); console.log("C3"); return; } const decrease = stats2024 < stats2023; const percentChange = ((stats2024 - stats2023) / stats2023 * 100).toFixed(1); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}%`); if (decrease) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
